assumptions: Harness records (SPEC-048 journal and observation, SPEC-049 evaluation and registry) keep their current fields, including attempt start and end times and the candidate hash. The OTel GenAI conventions stay readable at the pinned revision. The SPEC-047 store, batch v4 and consent rules stay as merged. Harbor trials (SPEC-084) reach spans only through ingested Agent Braid records.
compatibility: Additive. A new mapping contract agent-braid-otel-genai/v0.1 and a separate private span store; the SPEC-047 store, batch v4, vocabulary and consent are unchanged. Emission is off by default and export is a separate opt-in command. Rollback removes the trace commands and purges local span files; exported spans cannot be recalled.
domain: Spans derived from local harness attempt, trial and evaluation records, and their optional export to an operator-named loopback OTLP endpoint.
execution_contract: None. executionAuthorization is false on every result and agent_braid.execution_authorization is false on every span; no launch, grant, promotion or verdict. Only the explicit export command has a network effect.
hypotheses: H1: a metadata-only mapping keeps candidate identity, outcome class and infrastructure-error separation for every fixture record with zero content fields. T012 may refute it; a negative or inconclusive result is valid and closes the spec under REQ-011.
observation_contract: What the harness records say, mapped field by field through an allowlist at a pinned convention revision. Untimed events are counted, never given invented times; missing required attributes are flagged as conformance gaps; missing outcomes are unobserved. Spans are observation, not verdicts; hashes bind bytes, not authenticity.

requirements.text: Pinned conventions. The mapping contract names one revision of the semantic-conventions-genai repository (commit, date, schema URL, license). Every span file carries the pin and the mapping version. A file with an unknown pin or version is refused. A newer revision is adopted only by a reviewed change with a mapping diff.

requirements.text: Span model. One `invoke_agent` span per harness attempt or trial, with `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.agent.name` (closed value), `gen_ai.agent.id` (the SPEC-049 profile id when registered) and `gen_ai.agent.version` = `sha256:<hex>` of the candidate. One `execute_tool` child span per tool event that has recorded times, with `gen_ai.tool.name` from an allowlist or `other`. An evaluation run is a parent `invoke_workflow` span. Agent Braid fields use the `agent_braid.` namespace. Times are never invented: untimed events are counted on the parent, and a required attribute missing from the record is flagged as a conformance gap, never guessed.

requirements.text: SPEC-047 compatibility. The store, batch v4, vocabulary and consent stay unchanged. The contract documents how SPEC-047 operations and outcomes (for example `harness-compare`, `ok`/`refused`/`error`) map to span attributes, and how daily cells map to OTel metric semantics. Spans and cells join only by UTC day and operation.

requirements.text: Outcomes and infrastructure errors. A task failure is not a span error. An infrastructure error (SPEC-082 classes) sets span status ERROR and a closed `error.type`. A missing outcome is `unobserved`, never `ok`. Spans carry outcome classes only, no score and no verdict.

requirements.text: Noninterference. A fault while writing spans never changes harness records, output or exit codes. Overhead is measured and losses are counted.

requirements.text: Conditional adoption. The OpenTelemetry adoption track (AT-2026-004, `watch`) moves only through a recorded owner decision with an ADR covering the output contract and the export path. If the owner keeps `watch`, or the fixture check of H1 fails, the spec closes with a recorded "not adopted" outcome. That is a valid result.

scientific_limits: Engineering, not a research protocol. The OTel GenAI conventions are status Development and may change; conformance is to one pinned revision only. H1 is checked on committed fixtures only; no claim of compatibility with any backend. A loopback receipt shows attribute names, not backend behavior. A Codex review is independent model review, not human review or approval.
scope: Draft mapping contract agent-braid-otel-genai/v0.1 from harness records to OTel GenAI invoke_agent and execute_tool spans with gen_ai.agent.version set to the candidate hash; a private local span store under SPEC-047 consent rules; redaction of all content by default; opt-in loopback OTLP/HTTP JSON export; a SPEC-047 mapping that leaves that store unchanged; telemetry-audit coverage. Documentation only: nothing implemented, exported or published.
